scientific_integrity: The exact source recurrence and transverse linearizations have been reconstructed from the open full text; the general theorem follows by strict Jensen inequality. An exact irrational-logarithmic two-cycle yields rational predator Floquet multipliers and a strict prey multiplier bound. The attached standalone SymPy checker replays the 3D map, period orbit, Jacobian monodromy, and rational exponential bounds. Claims of independence or external certification are not made.
scientific_limitations: Strict comparison concerns nonconstant positive predator-free prey cycles, positive adult survival, and equal equilibrium linear replacement factors.
The exact Ricker example has nonmonotone offspring and is outside the seventh hypothesis of the source persistence theory.
Local Floquet invasion and noninvasion are not global population-outcome guarantees.
The full three-species periodic orbit is a saddle; the juvenile-only restriction is locally asymptotically stable.
Earliest verifiable dated public version is the authors’ 2025 conference poster, with first scheduled core session on 2025-07-09 UTC; online upload date is not established.
title: Adult survival creates a strict stage-specific invasion gap on prey cycles
